title: Performance metrics of triboelectric nanogenerator toward record-high output energy density
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00376H, Paper
Ru Guo, Hang Luo, Shaoshuai He, Xin Xia, Tingting Hou, Haoyu Wang, Chaojie Chen, Dou Zhang, Yunlong Zi
This work develops universal standardized performance metrics to quantitatively evaluate TENG's maximized output capability approaching the breakdown limit, creating record-high charge density (2.8 mC m−2) and output energy density (6.2 × 105 J m−3).
